title: Coordinate SDK upgrades and gradual legacy param sunset
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: bump and unify critical dependency versions across Redwood client libraries (python/js/go), simplify the public API by scheduling a controlled sunset for legacy request parameters, and provide automated compatibility shims and migration guides to avoid customer breakage.

Scope:
- Upgrade http transport libraries and core serialization deps: requests (Python) -> pinned 3.x, node-fetch/undici -> undici 5.x, go-http-client dependency pins.
- Upgrade test harnesses to pytest-8.x and jest 29.x.
- Remove/soft-deprecate legacy query parameters: `use_legacy_kv`, `compat_mode`, `old_token_format` from public constructors; add runtime warnings and telemetry for usage.
- Provide compatibility adapter in each SDK release (minor release) that maps legacy params to new surface for 2 release cycles, then hard remove in a major release.
- Update CI, Docker-based integration tests, and nightly-eval to exercise upgraded client matrix.

Acceptance criteria:
- All three language clients build cleanly and pass full unit+integration suite on CI (no skip).
- Backward-compat adapter emits a single telemetry event when legacy params are used.
- Migration guide published + in-repo examples for Python/JS/Go.
- No customer-facing regressions observed in canary (telemetry thresholds defined).

Rollout plan:
1) Create per-language feature branches with pinned dep bumps and adapter code (week 1).
2) Run cross-language compatibility matrix against runtime-1.22 staging (week 2).
3) Canary release to 5% of hosted traffic and selected internal customers (week 3).
4) Monitor telemetry (errors, latency, token cost) for 7d, roll forward or rollback based on threshold.
5) Announce deprecation timeline in release notes and customer dashboard; schedule removal in major release after 2 release cycles.

Risks and mitigations:
- Some older customers may pass legacy params from generated client code. Mitigate with runtime warning, telemetry, and an automated codemod for JS/Python to help migrate large customers.
- Upgrading transport libraries can change connection pooling behavior and increase latency in edge cases. Mitigate by load-testing with synthetic traces and verifying kernel/runtime metrics.

Notes: coordinate with SDK owners: @Priya (python), @Liam (go), @Sana (js). Link to design doc and canary dashboard in attachments.
